title: Set 99

sentences.ko: 여기까지 차 몰고 오기 전에 말해 둘 게 있는데, 오르막 올라갈 때 저단 기어가 헛돌아요. 고쳐야지 하면서 계속 미루다 결국 못 고쳤고요. 나머지는 다 멀쩡해요, 봄에 브레이크도 새로 갈았고요. 괜히 와서 오후만 날렸다는 기분 들게 하느니 지금 말해 주는 게 나을 것 같아서요.
sentences.text: Before you drive all the way out here I should tell you the low gears skip when you're going uphill, and I never got around to fixing it. Everything else on it is solid, I put new brakes on it in the spring. I'd just rather tell you now than have you show up and feel like I wasted your afternoon.

alts.text: Heads up before you make that whole drive out here, the low gears skip going uphill and I never got around to fixing it. Everything else is solid, I put new brakes on it in the spring. I'd rather just say it now than have you show up and feel like I wasted your afternoon.

Before you make the trip out here, I should mention that the low gears skip when you are going uphill, and I never got around to repairing it. Everything else on it is in good condition, and I installed new brakes in the spring. I would prefer to tell you now rather than have you arrive and feel that I had wasted your afternoon.

sentences.note: **never got around to** 는 마음은 있었는데 계속 미루다 끝내 못 했다는 뜻입니다. **drive all the way out here** 는 먼 길을 굳이 차로 온다는 느낌을 줍니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 드디어 기침 때문에 병원에 가 봤는데 별거 아니래요. 그냥 우리 집이 너무 건조해서 그런 거래요. 의사가 가습기 사고 물 많이 마시라던데, 그건 우리 엄마가 8월부터 계속 하던 말이거든요. 결국 엄마 말이 맞았다는 걸 확인하는 데 40달러 쓴 셈이죠.
sentences.text: I finally went in about that cough and it's nothing, it's just how dry it gets in my apartment. The doctor told me to get a humidifier and drink more water, which is exactly what my mother has been telling me since August. So that was forty dollars to find out my mom was right.

alts.text: So I finally got that cough checked out and it's nothing, my apartment's just really dry. Doc said get a humidifier and drink more water, which is exactly what my mom's been telling me since August. So that was forty dollars to find out she was right.

I finally had that cough looked at, and it is nothing. It is simply how dry my apartment gets. The doctor advised me to get a humidifier and to drink more water, which is precisely what my mother has been telling me since August. So it cost forty dollars to learn that she was correct.

sentences.note: **went in** 은 병원 같은 데를 직접 찾아가 봤다는 뜻의 캐주얼한 표현입니다. **it's nothing** 은 별일 아니라고 안심시킬 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 자, 그래서 요즘 어떻게 지냈어? 내가 아는 건 전부 우리 엄마한테 들은 거고, 엄마는 너희 언니한테 들은 거야. 마지막으로 들은 건 네가 이사할지도 모른다는 얘기였어. 진짜 이사한 거야, 아니면 아직 생각만 하고 있는 거야?
sentences.text: Okay, so what have you been up to? Because everything I know came through my mom, and she got it from your sister, and the last thing I heard was that you might be moving. Did that actually happen, or is it still one of those things you're thinking about?

alts.text: So come on, what's going on with you? Everything I know came from my mom, and she got it from your sister, and the last I heard you might be moving. Did that actually happen, or is that still a maybe?

So, what have you been doing lately? Everything I know has come through my mother, and she heard it from your sister, and the last thing I heard was that you might be moving. Did that in fact happen, or is it still something you are considering?

sentences.note: **what have you been up to** 는 오랜만에 만난 사람에게 그동안 어떻게 지냈냐고 묻는 인사말입니다. **one of those things you're thinking about** 은 아직 정하지 못하고 고민만 하는 일이라는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 솔직히 말해? 색은 너한테 정말 잘 어울려. 내가 자꾸 보게 되는 건 길이야. 조금만 더 위로 올라왔으면 아무 말도 안 했을 거야. 근데 입은 지 10분 됐는데 계속 잡아당기고 있잖아. 너도 이미 알고 있는 것 같은데.
sentences.text: Honestly? The color is great on you, it's the length I keep looking at. If it sat a little higher I don't think I would have said anything. But you've had it on for ten minutes and you keep pulling at it, so I think you already know.

alts.text: Want the honest answer? The color's great on you, it's the length I keep staring at. If it sat a bit higher I probably wouldn't have said anything. But it's been ten minutes and you keep tugging at it, so I think you already know.

May I be honest? The color looks wonderful on you. It is the length that I keep looking at. If it sat slightly higher, I do not think I would have said anything. However, you have had it on for ten minutes and you keep pulling at it, so I believe you already know.

sentences.note: **great on you** 는 옷이나 색이 그 사람에게 잘 어울린다는 뜻입니다. **it's the length I keep looking at** 처럼 신경 쓰이는 대상을 앞으로 빼면 그 부분이 강조됩니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 나는 첫째 주 주말이나 마지막 주말 둘 다 돼. 근데 첫째 주로 하면 일요일 밤 비행기로 돌아와야 해. 시댁 식구들이 월요일에 오거든. 그러니까 네가 일정을 좀 옮길 수 있으면 마지막 주말이 나아. 어차피 그때가 비행기표도 더 싸고. 목요일 전에는 알려 줘, 싼 표는 금방 나가.
sentences.text: I can do the first weekend or the last one, but if we go the first weekend I have to fly back Sunday night, because my in-laws get in on Monday. So the last one's better if you can move things around, and flights are cheaper then anyway. Just let me know before Thursday, the cheap ones go fast.

alts.text: Either the first weekend or the last one works, but if we do the first one I've gotta fly back Sunday night, because my in-laws get in Monday. So the last one's better if you can shuffle things around, and flights are cheaper then anyway. Just tell me before Thursday, the cheap ones go fast.

I am available either the first weekend or the last one, but if we choose the first weekend, I will have to fly back Sunday night, because my in-laws arrive on Monday. The last one would therefore be preferable if you are able to rearrange things, and in any case, flights are less expensive then. Please let me know before Thursday, as the inexpensive ones sell out quickly.

sentences.note: **get in** 은 비행기나 기차로 도착한다는 뜻입니다. **move things around** 는 일정을 이리저리 옮겨 조정한다는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 2번 formal: "had that cough examined", "obtain a humidifier", "how dry my apartment becomes" 가 지나치게 딱딱해서 원어민이 격식을 갖춰 말할 때도 안 쓰는 말이 됐습니다. "looked at", "get", "gets" 로 바꿔 말투만 올리고 뜻은 그대로 뒀습니다.
3번 casual: "one of those maybe things" 는 실제로 쓰지 않는 표현입니다. 같은 뜻을 구어로 말하는 "is that still a maybe?" 로 바꿨습니다.
4번 casual: "Real talk?" 는 쓰는 자리가 따로 있는 슬랭이라 친구 옷 얘기에는 어색합니다. "Want the honest answer?" 로 바꿨습니다.
4번 한국어: "솔직히 말해도 돼?" 는 허락을 구하는 말이라 영어의 "Honestly?" 와 어긋납니다(그 뜻은 formal 쪽의 "May I be honest?" 입니다). "솔직히 말해?" 로 맞췄습니다.
5번 formal: "flights are less expensive then in any case" 는 낱말 순서 때문에 한 번에 안 읽힙니다. "in any case, flights are less expensive then" 으로 옮겼습니다.
